source_snapshot.test_name_items: All HDD NVMe LED Check - Rebuild
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check if NVMe RAID rebuild LED function works normally

1. Insert NVMe SSD into BP slot and check present LED

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. Check system spec define LED function

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Undocumented raw IPMI bytes plus `lsblk` inventory.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: Management result, device list and rebuild LED observation.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; raw BMC/list commands neither define nor observe rebuild and overlook the Present-versus-Rebuild conflict.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; surfaces the conflict and requests degraded array, replacement member, rebuild trigger, LED mapping and recovery.

original_test_intent: The item/opening statement nominally target an all-HDD NVMe Rebuild LED check, while the sole numbered step performs insertion and checks the Present LED; the intended accepted hardware state is unresolved.
original_method: Retain two non-equivalent possible workflows pending an owner decision: a degraded-array replacement/rebuild with Rebuild LED evidence, or per-bay insertion with Present LED evidence. Do not infer one from the other or the filename.
manual_activity: Both possible interpretations require physical insertion and visual LED evidence, but execution must not begin until an engineer identifies the correct indicator, state transition and population.
required_inputs: Case-specific decision selecting Rebuild or Present LED
If Rebuild: approved degraded array, RAID level, replacement member, trigger/progress/completion
LED truth table, hot-plug/ESD, data disposition, OOB and recovery
safety_requirements: Do not create/degrade/rebuild an array based only on the title.
Do not report Present LED as Rebuild evidence or use raw BMC bytes to mask the conflict.
Protect boot, mounted, in-use, data-bearing and unknown media.
Require exact serial/bay mapping and qualified physical handling.
No automatic force, cancel, rebuild, retry, reinsert or recovery.
agent_execution_scope: Document the contradiction and maintain separate safe plans for each interpretation.
After owner resolution, validate population, topology, tools and recovery controls.
Automate only the approved controller/inventory evidence path.
Do not claim physical observation or engineer verdict.
engineer_actions: Resolve Rebuild versus Present and approve the authoritative expected state.
Define population, physical operation and storage recovery plan.
Perform/attest physical action and LED observation, then decide PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Unusable: undocumented raw IPMI and `lsblk` resolve neither the conflicting LED semantics nor rebuild state and may alter unrelated BMC state.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Issue no LED or storage-state command before resolution; afterward use documented controller rebuild telemetry or read-only presence inventory appropriate to the chosen path.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All-HDD title, Rebuild statement, insertion/Present step and 15/8-minute fields remain intact as the conflict record.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: For Rebuild, require degraded baseline, replacement insertion, rebuild phases and Rebuild LED; for Present, require per-bay insertion/enumeration and Present LED only.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record controller/backplane/BMC firmware and utility versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform LED truth table and controller rebuild guide.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Guessing could alter live RAID state and still validate the wrong LED.

project_override_considerations: A project may explicitly select one path without editing the master, but it must document the override and cannot claim the omitted behavior or untested bays.
expected_evidence: Owner resolution, selected LED specification and all-HDD population
Approved physical/storage plan and stable serial/bay mapping
Path-specific Present or rebuild state telemetry
Operator LED media, final health/recovery, Tool Result and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item and introductory sentence require Rebuild LED, but the only action checks Present LED and contains no degraded array, replacement, rebuild trigger or progress criterion. The signals are not interchangeable.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Core operation and accepted indicator are genuinely ambiguous. Choosing either path without owner resolution risks unsafe, irrelevant execution, satisfying the narrow V3.1 BLOCKED condition.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects its raw-command shortcut and missed semantic conflict.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Adopts its conflict analysis but changes classification from conditional partial to BLOCKED pending resolution.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Uses BLOCKED for the true operation ambiguity while retaining all contradictory source facts.

review_improvement: Prevents a per-bay Present observation or arbitrary BMC response from being mislabeled as rebuild validation.
independent_technical_reasoning: A rebuild indicator requires an active rebuild state; simple insertion establishes presence only. Because the source specifies both without precedence, no safe faithful execution plan exists yet.
no_automatic_retry: No execution or retry is permitted until the case owner resolves the test meaning.
